column2: How are you? I am fine, thank you.
The boy and the girl are my good friends.
column3: 这个男孩和这个女孩是我的好朋友。

column2: The man is my father, and the woman is my mother.
column3: 这位男士是我爸爸，这位女士是我妈妈。

column2: Please come to school at eight.
I read at night and play in the day.
It is rainy and cold today.
I like this T-shirt and these trousers.
column3: 我喜欢这件T恤和这条长裤。

column2: Put on your cap, your shirt and your skirt.
column3: 戴上帽子，穿上衬衫和裙子。

column2: These shoes are nice, and I like them.
column3: 这双鞋很好看，我喜欢它们。

column2: There are thirteen birds in the tree.
I have fourteen apples and fifteen pears.
column3: 我有十四个苹果和十五个梨。

column2: There are sixteen, seventeen and eighteen kites.
column3: 那儿有十六只、十七只和十八只风筝。

column2: Twenty children are in the park.
There is a big potato here.
There are many eggs, tomatoes and carrots.
column3: 这儿有很多鸡蛋、西红柿和胡萝卜。

column2: OK, wash your arm and your neck.
column3: 好的，洗洗你的胳膊和脖子。

column2: We play games on Children’s Day.
Every child likes to draw and paint.
column3: 每个孩子都喜欢画画和涂色。

column2: We watch a show at the party.
I go to school by bus.
I go to my hometown by ship.
I go to school by train, and my father goes by car.
column3: 我坐火车上学，我爸爸开车去。

column2: We can go by taxi, by plane or by bike.
column3: 我们可以坐出租车、坐飞机或者骑自行车去。
欢迎来到我们的食品厂！
那位男士是我们的老师。

column2: The woman is our teacher, too.
column3: 那位女士也是我们的老师。

column2: My father is a driver and my mother is a nurse.
column3: 我爸爸是司机，我妈妈是护士。

column2: The farmer, the worker and the doctor are here.
column3: 农民、工人和医生都在这儿。
